fact: Togo First reports a technical workshop on 4-7 May 2026 in Lomé, led by the Ministry of Health with GIZ and World Bank support, chose a federated architecture for the SIIG-AMU so existing platforms keep running while data is exchanged between hospitals, pharmacies, laboratories, managing bodies and insurers; the system is being prepared, with a roadmap and steering mechanisms worked on.
system: Système d'Information Intégré de Gestion de l'Assurance Maladie Universelle (SIIG-AMU)

fact: Atlantic Infos reports that WAHO opened a five-day regional workshop in Cotonou to pilot automated transfer of routine health data from national DHIS2 systems, with Togo one of four pilot countries.
system: WAHO automated routine health data sharing (DHIS2)
